declare
 wher varchar2(1000);
 s_name valid_territories.territory_name%TYPE;
 s_t_name valid_territories.territory_short_name%TYPE;
 s_terr_id valid_territories.territory_id%TYPE;

 cursor cur_territory is
 select a.territory_short_name, a.territory_name , a.territory_id 
 from valid_territories a 
 where ( a.territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.t_name
 or a.territory_short_name = :ctrl_block_1.t_name )
 and exists (select sponsor_id 
 from sponsors 
 where territory_id = a.territory_id)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

begin
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 if :ctrl_block_1.t_name is not null then
 open cur_territory;
 fetch cur_territory into
 s_t_name, s_name, s_terr_id;
 if cur_territory%NOTFOUND then
 show_error('11307');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select b.first_name||' '||b.last_name
 into :ctrl_block_1.recruiter
 from territory_assignments a, employees b
 where a.territory_id = s_terr_id and
 a.recruiter_id = b.staff_no and 
 sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, sysdate+1)
 and rownum = 1
 and b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :ctrl_block_1.recruiter := 'No Recruiter';
 When others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 :ctrl_block_1.name := s_name;
 :ctrl_block_1.t_name := s_t_name;
 :ctrl_block_1.territory_id := s_terr_id;
 end if;
 else
 show_error( '11018');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
:sponsors.disp_name := initcap(:sponsors.name);
declare
 dr_id varchar2(10);
begin
Begin
 select description into :sponsors.cat_desc
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'SPCAT' and code = :sponsors.category;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :sponsors.cat_desc := 'Not Found';
 End ;
 
 if :sponsors.status = 'A' then
 :sponsors.status_desc := 'A';
 else 
 :sponsors.status_desc := 'I';
 end if;

 Begin
 select count(drive_id) into :sponsors.drives
 from drive_sponsors 
 where sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;

 begin
 select max(b.DRIVE_DATE),max(a.PROJECTED_draw) 
 into :sponsors.LDRV_date, :sponsors.p_drw
 from drive_sponsors a, drives b
 where a.sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id and
 b.status = 'CNFRM' and
 a.DRIVE_ID = b.DRIVE_ID and 
 b.drive_date < sysdate
 and b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 begin
 select a.drive_id
 into dr_id
 from drive_sponsors a, drives b
 where a.sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id and
 b.status = 'CNFRM' and
 a.DRIVE_ID = b.DRIVE_ID and
 b.drive_date = :sponsors.LDRV_date and
 a.projected_draw = :sponsors.p_drw and
 b.drive_date < sysdate and 
 b.chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 and b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :sponsors.p_drw := 0;
 when too_many_rows then
 message('too many rows');pause;
 end;

 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when too_many_rows then
 message('too many rows');pause;
 end;

 begin
 select min(b.DRIVE_DATE)
 into :sponsors.NDRV_date
 from drive_sponsors a, drives b
 where a.sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id and
 b.status = 'CNFRM' and
 a.DRIVE_ID = b.DRIVE_ID and
 b.drive_date > sysdate and
 b.chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when too_many_rows then
 message('too many rows');pause;
 end;

 begin
 select count(A.transaction_id) into :sponsors.a_drw
 from Donations A,drive_sponsors B
 where B.sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id and
 B.drive_id = a.drive_id and
 B.drive_id = dr_id and
 A.chapter_id = B.chapter_id
 and A.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and B.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :sponsors.a_drw := 0;
 end ;

exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
End;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_COUNT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_count IS
BEGIN

 if :ctrl_block_1.select = 'ALL' then /* TOTAL NUMBER OF SPONSORS */
 if :ctrl_block_1.a_i != 'B' then 
 --message('a');pause;
 select count(distinct sponsor_id) into :ctrl_block_1.total_sp from sponsors
 where territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.territory_id
 and lob like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.lob,lob)
 and category like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.category,category) 
 and status = :ctrl_block_1.a_i and
 NVL(employee_base,0) >= nvl(:ctrl_block_1.d_base,0)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 select sum(employee_base) into :ctrl_block_1.donor_base from sponsors
 where territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.territory_id
 and lob like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.lob,lob)
 and category like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.category,category) 
 and status = :ctrl_block_1.a_i and
 NVL(employee_base,0) >= nvl(:ctrl_block_1.d_base,0)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 else
 select count(distinct sponsor_id) into :ctrl_block_1.total_sp from sponsors
 where territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.territory_id
 and lob like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.lob,lob)
 and category like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.category,category) and
 NVL(employee_base,0) >= nvl(:ctrl_block_1.d_base,0)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 where territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.territory_id
 and lob like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.lob,lob)

 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 if :ctrl_block_1.a_i != 'B' then 
 select count(distinct sponsor_id) into :ctrl_block_1.total_sp from sponsors
 where territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.territory_id
 and lob like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.lob,lob)

 and lob like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.lob,lob)
 and category like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.category,category) and
 status = :ctrl_block_1.a_i and
 NVL(employee_base,0) >= nvl(:ctrl_block_1.d_base,0)
 and SPONSOR_ID not in 
 (select distinct A.sponsor_id 
 from drive_sponsors A, drives B 
 where a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and ((b.drive_date between :ctrl_block_1.s_date-56 and :ctrl_block_1.s_date)
 OR (b.drive_date between :ctrl_block_1.E_date and :ctrl_block_1.E_date + 56)) )
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 else
 select count(distinct sponsor_id) into :ctrl_block_1.total_sp from sponsors
 where territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.territory_id
 and lob like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.lob,lob)
 and category like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.category,category) and
 NVL(employee_base,0) >= nvl(:ctrl_block_1.d_base,0)
 and SPONSOR_ID not in 
 (select distinct A.sponsor_id 
 from drive_sponsors A, drives B 
 where a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and ((b.drive_date between :ctrl_block_1.s_date-56 and :ctrl_block_1.s_date)
 OR (b.drive_date between :ctrl_block_1.E_date and :ctrl_block_1.E_date + 56)) )
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 select sum(employee_base) into :ctrl_block_1.donor_base from sponsors
 where territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.territory_id
 and lob like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.lob,lob)
 and category like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.category,category) and
 NVL(employee_base,0) >= nvl(:ctrl_block_1.d_base,0)
 and SPONSOR_ID not in 
 (select distinct A.sponsor_id

 end if;

PROCEDURE modify_where_condition IS
 wher varchar2(1000);
begin
 wher := wher||' and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and SPONSOR_ID not in (select distinct sponsor_id from drive_sponsors)';
 if :ctrl_block_1.a_i != 'B' then
 wher := 'territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.territory_id
 and lob like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.lob,lob)
 and category like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.category,category) and
 status = :ctrl_block_1.a_i and
 NVL(employee_base,0) >= nvl(:ctrl_block_1.d_base,0)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id';
 else
 wher := 'territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.territory_id
 and lob like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.lob,lob)
 and category like nvl(:ctrl_block_1.category,category) and
 NVL(employee_base,0) >= nvl(:ctrl_block_1.d_base,0)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id';
 end if; 
 
 if :ctrl_block_1.select = 'ALL' then
 set_block_property('sponsors',DEFAULT_WHERE,wher );
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block_1.select = 'ELG' then
 wher := wher ||' '|| 
 ' and SPONSOR_ID not in 
 (select distinct A.sponsor_id 
 from drive_sponsors A, drives B

 OR (b.drive_date between :ctrl_block_1.E_date and :ctrl_block_1.E_date + 56)) )';
 set_block_property('sponsors',DEFAULT_WHERE,wher );
 end if;
end;
